resources.string: Follow Roby on his security journey
It’s Roby’s first day at Uni Bundeswehr.
He is just starting his Bachelor in Computer Science and he’s so excited!
But first, Roby has to setup his university account.

Hey! It's nice, that you want to follow Roby on his password mission!

string-array.name: facts
string-array.item: Employees at Unibw spend about 80% of their working time at a computer. How secure is your online data?
The average person has around 50 online accounts. How do you remember so many passwords?
More than 80% of Unibw employees use the same passwords for multiple accounts. Let us change that!
123456 is still the most commonly used password worldwide. How secure are your passwords really?
Passwords like password and qwerty are still widely used. Do you have a secure password?
Over 80% of data leaks occur due to weak or stolen passwords. How well do you protect your online accounts?
Every second person has already forgotten a password and had to reset it. Are you one of them?
In cyber attacks, it often takes only seconds to crack a simple password. How long would yours last?
In 2022, every fourth person in Germany was affected by a cyber attack. How do you protect your data?
Only 1 in 3 people currently uses a password manager. Are you one of them?
Thousands of passwords are hacked every second. Is yours secure enough?
A good password manager could minimize 90% of security risks. Are you already using one?
